description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Archer], [Damage Cap +10000], [Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Water)] and [Triple Raining Arrows Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Archer
description.text: Sharpshooter abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Sharpshooter abilities

description.name: Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Water] after using a Fire/Ice/Water ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Triple Raining Arrows Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Fire Shield/Freeze Arrow/Rain Shot after using a Fire/Ice/Water Sharpshooter ability

description.name: Fire Shield
description.text: Two single ranged attacks (0.40 each), grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies, 100% hit rate

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Freeze Arrow
description.text: Two single ranged attacks (0.40 each), grants [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] to all allies every second cast, 100% hit rate

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Rain Shot
description.text: Two single ranged attacks (0.40 each), causes [Imperil Water 10% (15s)] every second cast, 100% hit rate
